Class client_RMI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.RMI.client_RMI
All Implemented Interfaces:
Network
public class client_RMI extends Object implements Network
Class responsible for establishing an RMI connection with the RMI server and handling all client-side remote method invocations

  • Field Details

    • remote

      private final RemoteMethods remote
      Remote reference to the server-side methods exposed through RMI. This object is used to invoke remote operations on the server.

  • Constructor Details

    • client_RMI

      public client_RMI(String serverIp, int port, String clientIp) throws RemoteException, NotBoundException
      Creates an RMI client and connects to the server registry to obtain a reference to the remote object used for invoking server-side methods. The client configures its RMI hostname and retrieves the remote reference from the server registry.
      Parameters:
      serverIp - the IP address of the server
      port - the RMI registry port
      clientIp - the IP address of this client used for RMI callbacks
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if a network communication error occurs
      NotBoundException - if the remote object is not found in the registry

      public String getLobby(String nickname, ClientController controller)
      Connects the client to the lobby and retrieves the current lobby state from the server. A remote callback is created to allow the server to send updates to the client.
      Specified by:
      getLobby in interface Network
      Parameters:

      controller - the client controller handling server updates
      Returns:
      the VirtualView identifier associated with the client session

    • createNewGame

      public boolean createNewGame(String nickname, int expectedNumPlayers, Color color, String viewId)
      Sends a request to the server to create a new game session in the lobby. The player becomes the host and selects their own color for in-game representation.
      Specified by:
      createNewGame in interface Network
      Parameters:
      nickname - the name of the player creating the game
      expectedNumPlayers - the number of players required for the game
      color - the player's chosen color
      viewId - the identifier of the client view connection
      Returns:
      true if the request was successfully sent to the server; false otherwise

    • joinGame

      public boolean joinGame(String nickname, int id, Color color, String viewId)
      Sends a request to join an existing game session in the lobby. The player is added to the specified game if it exists and has available slots.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
      nickname - the name of the player joining the game
